claims: The Netherlands defeated Norway 2-1 in an international friendly.
The match took place on March 27, 2026.
The match took place at the Johan Cruyff Arena in Amsterdam.
Norway took the lead in the first half through Andreas Schjelderup.
Virgil van Dijk equalized before halftime.
Tijjani Reijnders scored the winner in the second half.
The match ended Norway's long unbeaten run.
The match was a preparation game for the FIFA World Cup.
Norway played without striker Erling Haaland.
